reviews.title: Great device, lousy app
reviews.text:
The operate device works great. You can calibrate it to individual posture and it will vibrate to let you know if you fall into a slouch. 
The 3.0.16 app on the other hand, is very buggy. A lot of times it cuts out, fails to log time, or logs way too much time. I will be using it for an hour and then the app only log about 20 minutes. Or sometimes it goes the other way, where I’ll wear it for an hour and it will log  something like 700 minutes.
The app also seems to randomly specify goals for the day. Some days it will be 60 minutes, some days 90, and sometimes 120. It seems very random, and there’s no way to override or configure this.
Overall, the device is great, but don’t expect much out of the app.
